# Sustained criss-cross: two branches commit and merge each other round after
# round, so history stacks synthetic virtual bases and re-signs the shared
# history repeatedly. Every round's merge (after the first) has 2+ merge bases.
# The content set-difference must keep locating "what's new" through all of it -
# no change may be lost, and each finalize (pre-commit verify) must pass.
#
# Each round: X and Y each add a distinct group to bob, tag their tip, then X
# merges Y's tip and Y merges X's tip. bob accumulates every group.

sesam-repo

exec sesam tell --user bob --recipient $BOB_PUBKEY --group dev
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'base: bob'

exec git checkout -b X
exec git checkout -b Y X~0

# ── round 1 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
exec git checkout X
exec sesam user change-groups --user bob --group-add gx1
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'x1'
exec git tag t-x1

exec git checkout Y
exec sesam user change-groups --user bob --group-add gy1
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'y1'
exec git tag t-y1

exec git checkout X
! exec git merge t-y1
exec git commit --no-edit

exec git checkout Y
! exec git merge t-x1
exec git commit --no-edit

# ── round 2 (now a criss-cross: X and Y each already merged the other) ────────
exec git checkout X
exec sesam user change-groups --user bob --group-add gx2
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'x2'
exec git tag t-x2

exec git checkout Y
exec sesam user change-groups --user bob --group-add gy2
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'y2'
exec git tag t-y2

exec git checkout X
! exec git merge t-y2
exec git commit --no-edit

exec git checkout Y
! exec git merge t-x2
exec git commit --no-edit

# ── round 3 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
exec git checkout X
exec sesam user change-groups --user bob --group-add gx3
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'x3'
exec git tag t-x3

exec git checkout Y
exec sesam user change-groups --user bob --group-add gy3
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'y3'
exec git tag t-y3

exec git checkout X
! exec git merge t-y3
exec git commit --no-edit

exec git checkout Y
! exec git merge t-x3
exec git commit --no-edit

# ── final integration ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
exec git checkout X
! exec git merge Y
exec git commit --no-edit

# The whole tangle verifies, and every round's change survived in the log.
exec sesam verify
exec sesam show .sesam/audit/log.jsonl
stdout 'gx1'
stdout 'gy1'
stdout 'gx2'
stdout 'gy2'
stdout 'gx3'
stdout 'gy3'
